targetState.statement: The application login holds no INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE on account or membership; any retained lock column grant is proven immutable for identity, authority and linked records.

The application login cannot execute transition_job; ordinary and imported job inserts cannot carry prohibited initial state, price, cap or policy; actor-less practice routes refuse outside the trusted practice database.
Only the command-checked activation, acceptance and settlement signatures remain executable by the application login; the v1 signatures are withdrawn and callers converted.
The application login has no INSERT on audit_event and no EXECUTE on the audit head routines; the database allocates sequence, hashes and time.
Receipts, resolutions and authorizations are created and completed only by checked begin and complete routines; the application login holds no direct INSERT on them and no receipt UPDATE.

Customer invoice, credit, payment, reversal and number-sequence tables are SELECT-only for the application login; money moves only through checked routines that bind actor, resource, amount, state and exact approval.
Evidence, prevention-fact and outbox writes reach the database only through checked, actor-bound paths; the worker uses its own login.

Every remaining direct commitment writer (quotes, variations, recovery, procurement, scope and proposals) is converted to a checked routine or reviewed as working data with its downstream effect recorded.
Checked routines compare p_actor and p_tenant with the protected session binding; the application login cannot choose another actor or tenant.
Row-level-security tenant policies use the protected bound tenant rather than a caller-set setting; views and privileged routines are reviewed.
New chokepoints and relevant money routines are owned by narrow no-login roles with only the grants and helpers they need; the application login cannot assume them.
No SECURITY DEFINER routine retains PUBLIC EXECUTE.

recorded.note: Routine, RLS policy and trigger protection facts recorded for review. They are NOT compared by any guard: comparison of reviewed routine and RLS definitions is held under the Q2 ruling (LP0-13). CH-4-C 0201: seven new routines and five changed definitions are source-inspected only; their null definitionSha256 values require exact PostgreSQL catalogue capture in CI. New public signatures are restricted to ch4_record_work_state(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb) and ch4_link_post_lock_job(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb); no other ACL is changed.
